improvements.rationale: These tags improve search engine visibility by clearly communicating the product value proposition within the recommended 155-character meta description limit. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. Including the free trial offer and starting price creates immediate clarity and encourages click-through.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the brand name and core function, building recognition. The subheading stacks three concrete value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), clearly identifies the target audience, and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no payment commitment. The copy is concise, benefit-driven, and creates a low-risk entry point to conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a GDN AI member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. By clearly explaining what happens next and reinforcing the low entry price and value included, it reduces uncertainty and supports conversion at the paywall moment.
